purpose: Machine-readable description of dashboard presentation, data dependencies, filter semantics, build/deploy workflow, validation and promotion.

required_semantics.species: Use consolidated final species values; multi-valued records are allowed.
required_semantics.geography: Use consolidated final primary country / ISO3 values; multi-valued records are allowed.
required_semantics.topics: Use authoritative V3 hierarchical topic paths.
required_semantics.publication_year: Exact publication year from the record.

updater_integration.target_state: When updater workflows are finalised, they should promote the validated updated master to data/master/current/living_evidence_map_master.csv. The production dashboard workflow then rebuilds docs/dashboard.json automatically.
updater_integration.presentation_independence: Routine evidence updates must not rewrite dashboard presentation HTML.
updater_integration.no_llm_rerun_for_dashboard: Dashboard refresh consumes the promoted master and existing topic annotations; it must not rerun topic classification merely to render the dashboard.

species_topic_heatmap.topic_axis_filter_link: filter database to clicked topic and selected species if species is not All species

topic_hierarchy.colour_rule: High-level branches span full project palette; descendants inherit and lighten parent/root hue.

filter_semantics.figure_clicks: replace all existing database filters before applying the figure-specific filter
filter_semantics.clear_filters: reset species, country, publication year, topic and text query
filter_semantics.topic_matching: A selected topic path matches the exact path and all descendant paths.
filter_semantics.top_level_topic: Top-level topic values are valid database filter values and match all descendants.

routine_update.precondition: Validated updater has promoted a new canonical master.
automatic_sequence: Dynamic last-search / last-evidence-update status is patched into the Pages artifact.
Deploy dashboard to GitHub Pages workflow publishes docs.

preview_refresh.note: Preview workflow temporarily substitutes the CORRECTED master while building preview JSON, then restores production dashboard.json before deployment.

promotion.effect: Copies the approved preview presentation to docs/index.html, removes preview-only banner, switches data fetch from dashboard-redesign-temp.json to dashboard.json, and validates the result.

validation.intent: Detect accidental loss of required controls, chart interactions, source paths or filter semantics before deployment.
